# Motia Group

> Motia Group is a real estate developer and builder based in Zirakpur, Punjab, delivering residential, commercial and industrial developments across the Chandigarh Tricity region (Zirakpur, Mohali, Panchkula) and North India, including Haryana industrial plots.

Corporate Office: Motia'z Royal Business Park, Corporate Office, 4th Floor, Chandigarh-Ambala Highway, Zirakpur, Punjab, India.
Phone: +91 8860095959. Email: info@motiagroup.com.

## Residential Projects

- [Motia'z Harmony Greens](https://www.motiagroup.com/motia-harmonygreens): Ongoing premium residences in Sanauli, Zirakpur, near PR-7 Airport Road.
- [Motia'z Royal Citi](https://www.motiagroup.com/motiaz-royal-citi): Delivered 23-acre residential and commercial project in Zirakpur.
- [Motia'z Gill Estate](https://www.motiagroup.com/motia-gill-estate): Delivered residential plots and township in Kurali, near Mohali.
- [Motia Heights](https://www.motiagroup.com/motia-heights): Delivered 3 BHK apartments in Dhakoli, Zirakpur.
- [Motia Citi](https://www.motiagroup.com/motia-citi): Delivered residential plots on Chandigarh-Ambala Highway, Zirakpur.
- [Motia HUYS](https://www.motiagroup.com/motia-huys): Delivered 2 & 3 BHK independent floors on Peer Muchalla Road, Zirakpur.

## Commercial & Industrial Projects

- [Motia'z Royal Business Park](https://www.motiagroup.com/motiaz-royal-business-park): Delivered office space on NH-22, Zirakpur.
- [Motia High Street](https://www.motiagroup.com/motia-high-street): Delivered commercial shops on VIP Road, Zirakpur.
- [Haryana Industrial Plots](https://www.motiagroup.com/haryana-industrial-plots): Ongoing industrial plots at Saha, on NH-344, Haryana.
